fixture: Eight-cell ring. Cell 3's function is redundant with the independently available binary sensor at immediate neighbors 2 and 4. During 64 pre-lesion time steps, each intact neighbor locally observes its own sensor and the next-step functional output of adjacent cells (only neighbor data). Cell 3 is then destroyed and replaced blank; no pre-lesion cell-3 weights, restored state, global labels or post-lesion target outputs are available.
test: Require one-hop neighbor messages formed from retained local predictive statistics and correct 16 novel function predictions after blank regrowth; compare blank cell/no neighbor records, neighbor-copy conventional control and equally-informed lookup control; no claims of superior efficiency.
negative: Unrecoverable function output independent of neighbor observables. Both local response conditionals must remain uninformative, and repaired cell must abstain (zero false function claims).
mechanism: two local conditional Bernoulli tables per cell predicting immediate neighbor output from own current binary sensor; synchronous one-edge message delivery to immediate neighbors; regeneration from received predictions only
acceptance: Information demonstrably retained in surviving neighbors, one-edge-per-round propagation, useful blank-cell function restoration with no new target supervision, and abstention on irrecoverable control. No general developmental specialization or faster-than-conventional recovery claim.
